D/ IMP AVRELIANVS AVG ; R/ RESTITVT ORBIS

A copper alloy Radiate (antoninianus) of Aurelian. Reece period:13 [260-275]. Obverse description: Radiate cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: IMP AVRELIANVS AVG. Reverse description: Woman presents wreath to Emperor on right holding spear. Reverse inscription: RESTITVT ORBIS. Degree of wear: Very worn: fair. Reverse mint mark: P = Mediolanum?
